data.body:
Orchestrator handoff: background epic-driver agent stopped for session handoff.

A single background agent (id 0a5d40a4-7667-4fc3-bc0a-4f07addb9517) was run for
~14.5 hours driving epic 78f2-b104-e3c9-4b86 (alias equitable-snazzy-fruitfly,
"Janitor Cleanup 2026-08-29") forward: claiming tickets, decomposing several
SKIPPED_NEEDS_PLANNING stories into executable children, running TDD loops,
and landing a sequence of Gerrit changes to main (2559, 2571-2575, 2577,
2578, 2581, 2583, all confirmed MERGED with LLM-Review+1/Verified+1).

The orchestrating user flagged that driving this epic via a single
long-running background agent inside one continuous context is a serious
execution-model error for this project and directed a stop. The agent was
instructed to halt all new work and bring state to a safe stopping point
rather than continue. It complied cleanly:

- Worktree /Users/joeoakhart/janitor-cleanup-equitable-snazzy-fruitfly:
  git status clean, no uncommitted changes, no stash created (nothing to
  stash), no stray background shells/processes left running.
- In-progress tickets at handoff:
  - 78f2-b104-e3c9-4b86 (epic, parent) - in_progress, descendants still open.
  - 0cfc-e511-8f8a-4c8b (mechanical-bitter-basenji, parent story) -
    in_progress, children still open.
  - ec79-7afb-c6a8-4af9 (girly-glittery-anemone) - claimed, code committed
    (45337a42600e) and pushed as Gerrit 2585 (LLM-Review +1, Verified
    pending). Not yet closable.
  - fdd1-12fa-ce83-45d1 (commonlaw-subsonic-quetzal) - claimed, code
    committed (273cd63a1fcf) and pushed as Gerrit 2587, stacked above 2585
    (no votes yet). Not yet closable.
  - 828b-fe4a-b05a-48fb (sapphire-cosmogonic-cob) - claimed after a fresh
    review-plan PASS, no code started yet - clean resume point.
- Known blockers recorded: 8ca7-28c5-c5c4-4f32 (ADR, needs human approval),
  8eff-87c1-d09a-4893 (overlaps 8ca7 on ADR files), b35a-abf6-02fd-4b31
  (genuine review-plan BLOCK needing plan rewrite/decomposition), and the
  pre-existing baseline test failure
  tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py::test_relevant_remote_rejection_never_places_candidate_on_shared_head
  (confirmed failing identically on a clean origin/main clone - not caused
  by any of this epic's changes).
- Independently re-verified by the orchestrator (not just trusting the
  agent's self-report): git status clean, Gerrit 2581/2583 confirmed MERGED
  with both votes green, 2585 confirmed LLM-Review+1/Verified-pending, 2587
  confirmed no votes yet, and the one running pytest process visible on the
  host at handoff time was confirmed (via lsof cwd) to belong to a
  completely unrelated worktree (reb-9ea3-mem-metrics), not this one.

Next session picking this up should resume from: claim state above, the 2585
stack awaiting CI, ticket 828b ready for its TDD loop, and the ~11 remaining
SKIPPED_NEEDS_PLANNING stories plus the ADR/blocked items still pending.
Whatever new session takes over should reconsider the execution model itself
(e.g. multiple parallel focused agents/subagents per the project's documented
parallel-agent ticket workflow, rather than one continuous single-context
background agent serializing the entire epic) before resuming.
